title: Pemetrexed increases BRCA1 protein stability and sensitizes TNBC cells to radiotherapy.
authors: Jin, Hee; Jeon, Kyung-Hwa; Kang, Chaerin; Lee, Joohyun; Lee, Yeonjin; Kwon, Youngjoo; Lee, Yun-Sil
one_liner_zh: 该文研究药物Pemetrexed通过稳定BRCA1蛋白增强三阴性乳腺癌放疗敏感性，虽涉及BRCA1蛋白稳定性与DNA损伤修复，但核心是药物-蛋白互作与细胞表型，无蛋白质-DNA结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题TF-DNA互作建模无关。
abstract: BRCA1 is a multifunctional tumor suppressor that orchestrates homologous recombination repair, chromatin remodeling, cell cycle control and apoptosis. Although pathogenic BRCA1 mutations are relatively uncommon, decreased BRCA1 protein expression, which is typically driven by accelerated proteasomal degradation, is implicated in aggressive breast cancer (BC), particularly triple‑negative (TN)BC. These mutations may modulate therapeutic response to DNA‑damaging agents. Given the absence of clinically available strategies to restore BRCA1 stability, the present study evaluated whether pemetrexed (Peme), a multitargeted antifolate identified through an in silico US Food and Drug Administration‑approved drug screen, modulates BRCA1 protein homeostasis in TNBC models. BRCA1 protein abundance, ubiquitination and turnover were assessed using immunoblotting, ubiquitin pull‑down and cycloheximide chase analyses and BRCA1 domain mutants. Functional consequences of Peme treatment were measured by apoptosis assay and BRCA1‑dependent signaling readouts. The radiosensitizing effect of Peme was evaluated in vitro and validated in TNBC xenografts. Peme increased BRCA1 protein levels without altering BRCA1 mRNA, indicating post‑translational regulation. Mechanistically, in silico docking and BRCA1 deletion mutant analyses suggested that the BRCA1 C‑terminal domain may contribute to the effect of Peme on BRCA1 stability, suppressing ubiquitin‑mediated proteasomal degradation and resulting in protein stabilization. Stabilized BRCA1 enhanced apoptotic responses, whereas BRCA1 knockdown attenuated these effects. Combined Peme‑radiation treatment significantly potentiated cytotoxicity in vitro and inhibited tumor growth in vivo, demonstrating a radiosensitizing effect linked to BRCA1 stabilization. Collectively, these findings identified Peme as a BRCA1‑stabilizing agent that enhances therapeutic response to radiation in TNBC. Pharmacological restoration of BRCA1 stability represents a promising strategy to overcome therapeutic resistance in BRCA1‑deficient or functionally compromised BC.
abstract_zh: BRCA1是一种多功能肿瘤抑制因子，协调同源重组修复、染色质重塑、细胞周期控制和凋亡。尽管致病性BRCA1突变相对罕见，但BRCA1蛋白表达降低（通常由加速的蛋白酶体降解驱动）与侵袭性乳腺癌（BC）相关，尤其是三阴性乳腺癌（TNBC）。这些突变可能调节对DNA损伤剂的治疗反应。鉴于临床上缺乏恢复BRCA1稳定性的可用策略，本研究评估了培美曲塞（Peme）——一种通过计算机模拟美国食品药品监督管理局批准药物筛选鉴定出的多靶点抗叶酸药物——是否调节TNBC模型中的BRCA1蛋白稳态。使用免疫印迹、泛素pull-down和环己酰亚胺追踪分析以及BRCA1结构域突变体评估BRCA1蛋白丰度、泛素化和周转。通过凋亡实验和BRCA1依赖性信号读数测量Peme处理的功能后果。Peme的放射增敏效应在体外评估并在TNBC异种移植瘤中验证。Peme在不改变BRCA1 mRNA的情况下增加BRCA1蛋白水平，表明存在翻译后调控。机制上，计算机模拟对接和BRCA1缺失突变体分析提示BRCA1 C末端结构域可能有助于Peme对BRCA1稳定性的效应，抑制泛素介导的蛋白酶体降解并导致蛋白稳定化。稳定的BRCA1增强凋亡反应，而BRCA1敲低减弱这些效应。Peme联合放射治疗在体外显著增强细胞毒性并在体内抑制肿瘤生长，证明与BRCA1稳定化相关的放射增敏效应。总体而言，这些发现将Peme鉴定为一种BRCA1稳定化剂，增强TNBC对放射的治疗反应。药理学恢复BRCA1稳定性代表一种有前景的策略，以克服BRCA1缺陷或功能受损BC中的治疗耐药性。
